answer: The sparrow register is checked at draw time, shale lists the eligible set, and crystal seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 44 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 44 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 6 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
